messages:
Marie (sales): Quick question — POC with CozyPay wants us to waive the hosted API usage floor for a 6-week POC. They expect ~20M tokens but traffic is spiky. Any precedent or quick thumbs-up/downs?
Sam E (eng): Do they need streaming? avg tokens/request? token shape matters for cost.
Marie (sales): Yes streaming chat. Avg ~600 tokens per request at peak, lots of short heartbeats too. They explicitly asked for per-token pricing matching a higher tier during the POC but no upfront commit.
Alex S (acct exec): We can do a temporary per-token override to effectively put them into Tier 2 pricing for a fixed window. Need deal desk sign-off. Prefer we add a hard cap so finance exposure is bounded. :+1:
Lisa Finance: Need the $ delta between current billed estimate and the proposed override. Also: is this likely to lead to a committed deal? Finance favors credits or capped discount over removing floors entirely. If waiver, require SOW with explicit end date + cap.
Jordan (salesops): Alternative: issue a time-limited credit pool + throttle policy when credits are exhausted. Less risky than changing rate cards.
Sam E (eng): Technically we can set a per-customer token override in routing. Example config snippet we can apply server-side quickly:
```
routing:
  customer_id: "cozypay"
  token_price_override: 0.0006  # per-token USD
  cap_tokens: 25000000
  override_ttl_days: 45
```
Marie (sales): If deal desk approves, legal/EPD want a 45-day trial clause + data retention and deletion terms documented.
DealDeskBot: Ticket DD-412 opened by @Marie (sales) — request: hosted usage-floor waiver for CozyPay POC. Assigned: @Lisa Finance. Status: needs justification + cap.
Lisa Finance: I'll need estimated run-rate, gross margin delta, and a clear success metric for converting to paid commit. Marie, can you get CozyPay's success criteria and expected conversion rate after POC? cc @Alex S
Alex S (acct exec): I'll add CRM notes and draft a short business justification. My initial ask: 45-day Tier2 override, $18k max exposure. If legal ok, I can sign the waiver.
Jordan (salesops): :eyes: vote?
Alex S (acct exec): :+1: on 45d override + cap.
Marie (sales): Action items: Marie -> collect CozyPay conversion metrics & usage profile (EOD). Alex -> CRM justification & ask. Sam -> prepare routing/config template. Lisa -> review margin and decide. I'll update DD-412 when I have numbers. Thanks all!
